This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 11-03-2026 (the "Effective
Date") by and between Mumbai Engineering Works Pvt Ltd, with its registered office at 22 MG Road,
Chennai ("Party A"), and Ganga Pharma Ltd, with its registered office at Plot 14, MIDC Industrial
Area, Chennai ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 36 months from the Effective Date unless
terminated earlier in accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall
use it solely for the purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Switzerland.
